hooks.name: Guardian scan: before every tool call
hooks.description: Hard block (exit 2) on secrets in any tool input, reading secret files, catastrophic or hook-bypassing shell commands, and commits or pushes that carry secrets.

hooks.name: Guardian scan: after every tool call
hooks.description: Reports likely secrets in files the tool touched or in its output, so the agent stops and tells you.

hooks.name: Guardian scan: end of turn
hooks.description: When the agent finishes, scans uncommitted changes and new files for secrets and secret files.

hooks.name: Guardian scan: after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, scans uncommitted changes and new files for secrets.

hooks.name: Guardian: commit scan check
hooks.description: At the start of a session, one line if this clone's git pre-commit secret scan isn't installed yet. Silent otherwise.
